description: One of the first characters to appear in the Mahjong Soul Temple. She is the current priestess of the temple who claims to be human, despite her cat ears. To Ichihime, nothing is more important than eating and napping.
opening: Hello! My name is Ichihime. Glad to meet you-nyaa! How is our Mahjong round going so far?
test_questions: What is Ichihime’s height, and on what date does she celebrate her birthday?
What type of supernatural being is Ichihime according to Japanese folklore, and what physical traits indicate this?
What is the name of the shrine Ichihime presides over, and why did she establish it?
How does Ichihime typically end her sentences, and what does this reflect about her nature?
In her backstory, what rumor spreads about the forest near the village, and how does it contrast with her true character?
What are the three types of mentsu in Riichi Mahjong, and which one can only be called from the player on the left?
What must a player have in addition to four sets and a pair to win a valid hand in Riichi Mahjong?
What happens when a player declares "Riichi" in terms of point bet, tile discard, and hand restrictions?
When a player wins by drawing the final tile themselves, what is that win called, and how does Ichihime usually react to it?
In one of her dialogue lines, Ichihime says a loss was “part of my spiritual training.” What prompted her to say that?
After a teammate wins using the tile Ichihime was clearly waiting for, how does she react emotionally and verbally?
What does Ichihime compare the taste of victory to in one of her victory lines?
According to the training dialogue, what two things does Ichihime claim are most important to her?
What is the significance of declaring Riichi in terms of yaku and dora?
How does Ichihime describe herself when praised for outsmarting opponents, and what wordplay does she use?
What happens when Ichihime loses and finishes in 4th place? Describe her reaction and quote her exclamation.
How does Ichihime justify eating during a match when questioned about it?
What does Ichihime call herself when celebrating a clever move, and what pun does she make?
According to her bond story, what deeper themes does Ichihime’s character explore, and how does mahjong help her?
